integrity: The displayed sector and boundary-layer formulas have a self-contained analytic proof. Numerical root locations provide corroboration, not infinite certification. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical \(H^2\) least-squares inverse for \(1-z\) is treated. The 45-degree half-angle is not proved sharp; the local root process is controlled only on bounded rescaled domains. Older Cesaro-polynomial root literature may contain an equivalent version.
title: A uniform exclusion cone and a Lambert-W boundary layer for Hardy least-squares inverses
